description: Reviewed boundaries for raw colour syntax (owner decision C18, 2026-11-08: every colour from the dynamic or static palette, C17). scripts/colour-inventory-lib.mjs finds hex literals, colour functions with literal or Sass-computed channels, and named colours in value positions; a finding outside every rule is unreviewed and tests/colour-inventory.test.mjs fails on it. A rule records a reviewed boundary; it does not make a raw colour a palette colour. Rules with status deferred-* name the decision that removes them.

rules.reason: The occurrence is inside a source comment and cannot reach emitted CSS or runtime style.
Vendored source is inventoried but changed only through an upstream update (the HCT colour utilities name their channels red, green and blue).

Examples, probes, studio fixtures and generated first-paint snapshots: values a person types into a colour setting (sf-input-color, sf-theme-generator), probe colours that prove an inherited value arrives (rgb(1, 2, 3)), element ids (#acc) and the static markup of a template, regenerated from it.
The minimal example of a colour setting shows the value a person types.
This policy quotes the values it reviews.

The palette primitives (white, black, transparent, the tonal palettes and their alpha steps; the static palette, generated by scripts/generate-static-palette.mjs) and the legacy Sass colour maps are the definitions every role and utility reads.
The theme generator's default seed colour (#005bbe); every dynamic palette is computed from it.

The five low-vision schemes are fixed contrast pairs independent of the theme; they are declared once here as --sf-special-<scheme> and --sf-on-special-<scheme> and read by the scheme rules and the panel's swatches.
Other companies' marks keep their own brand colours.
A port kit case: a record value a host stores, not a colour the Framework paints.
A mask gradient reads only the alpha of its colour stops; the colour is never painted.
The Loader and preloader paint before core.css arrives; their fallbacks are the theme's own page and ink values for that moment.

sf-input-color's own picker (owner decision C83) draws the colour space itself: the hue strip's six stops, the shade area's pure hue and the hue thumb are hues at full saturation, which no palette colour can stand for. Everything else in the picker reads palette tokens.
The hue strip's thumb is painted the hue it stands on, at full saturation (see input-color-colour-space).
